completion_promises.criterion_text: ForgeNotificationsSubscriber.__init__ accepts nats_client, routing_history_writer, queue_cap, correlation_cap. (queue_cap is not used by the subscriber itself but kept for API symmetry with the lifecycle wiring contract.)
completion_promises.evidence: ForgeNotificationsSubscriber.__init__ accepts nats_client and routing_history_writer as positional and queue_cap (default 100), correlation_cap (default 1000) and stop_timeout (default 5.0) as keyword-only kwargs. queue_cap is stored on _queue_cap but not consumed inside the subscriber — it survives for lifecycle wiring symmetry. Verified by TestConstructorSignature::test_init_accepts_all_documented_kwargs.

completion_promises.criterion_text: start() creates an ephemeral push consumer on pipeline.stage-complete.> with deliver_policy=NEW; idempotent on double-call.
completion_promises.evidence: start() calls self._nats_client.js.subscribe('pipeline.stage-complete.>', cb=self._on_message, ordered_consumer=False, deliver_policy=DeliverPolicy.NEW). The _started latch makes a second call a no-op. Verified by TestStart::test_start_subscribes_with_deliver_policy_new and TestStart::test_start_is_idempotent.

completion_promises.criterion_text: stop() cancels the consumer and returns within 5s even if the broker is unresponsive (Group D #14 scenario).
completion_promises.evidence: stop() awaits subscription.unsubscribe() inside asyncio.wait_for(timeout=self._stop_timeout, default 5.0); TimeoutError and any other exception are caught and logged WARN — never raised. Verified by TestStop::test_stop_returns_within_timeout_on_hung_broker (uses stop_timeout=0.05 + a 60s side_effect to confirm bounded return).

completion_promises.criterion_text: register_correlation populates an LRU dict, evicts oldest at cap, logs one WARN per eviction (Group B #3-4 scenarios).
completion_promises.evidence: register_correlation uses an OrderedDict; when full and key is new, popitem(last=False) evicts the oldest entry and emits exactly one WARN forge_correlation_evicted via structlog. Verified by TestRegisterCorrelation::test_register_evicts_oldest_at_cap (cap=2 + three registrations confirms c-1 is gone, c-2 and c-3 remain).

completion_promises.criterion_text: Re-registering the same correlation_id is silently overwritten (idempotent register, not a duplicate-error) per DDR-028 §Consequences.
completion_promises.evidence: register_correlation pops the existing entry before checking cap, so re-registering an existing key is a silent overwrite with no eviction and no log line. Verified by TestRegisterCorrelation::test_register_same_id_is_silently_overwritten.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On each delivered message: envelope validated, source_id='forge' enforced, correlation looked up, edge written via routing_history_writer.append_build_queue_event, notification enqueued via session_manager.enqueue_notification.
completion_promises.evidence: _handle_message validates MessageEnvelope.model_validate_json, gates on source_id == 'forge', validates StageCompletePayload, looks up the correlation in the OrderedDict, awaits routing_history_writer.append_build_queue_event(correlation_id, payload.model_dump(mode='json')), constructs a ForgeNotification, then calls session_manager.enqueue_notification(session_id, notification). Verified by TestHappyPath::test_message_routes_to_writer_and_session.

completion_promises.evidence: When envelope.source_id != 'forge', the handler emits logger.warning('forge_notification_dropped_unknown_source', source_id=..., correlation_id=...) and returns before any side-effect. Verified by TestUnknownSourceDropped — neither writer nor session_manager are touched.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Extra unknown fields tolerated (extra='ignore') — no rejection (Group D #8 scenario).

completion_promises.criterion_text: If session_manager is unbound when a message arrives, queue the notification on a buffer drained at bind_session_manager time (or drop gracefully — design.md §8 chooses drop with WARN; verify against design).
